thread:
elaine: Heads up - canary promotion hung at 3% and metrics show a latency regression on /generate endpoint. deploybot paused auto-promotion.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for commit qwe987asd due to canary health check breach: endpoint /v1/generate p95 latency = 1.8s (SLO 0.6s). Auto-promote canceled.

ravi: oh no. is this a model change or an infra config (batching/threads) tweak? any recent flags flipped in the canary config?

elaine: release diff shows runtime flag `--prefetch-cache=true` enabled in the new image. Could be causing extra warm-up traffic or contention. Also saw more open file descriptors in canary logs.

pat: quick tail from canary pod:
```
[2026-03-22T10:04:12Z] WARN runtime: cache prefetch hit race, opening fd 1024
[2026-03-22T10:04:13Z] ERROR serve: request latency 1.92s path=/v1/generate
[2026-03-22T10:04:14Z] INFO kvcache: eviction running
```

metrics-bot: Canary metrics snapshot (last 5m): p50=120ms, p95=1.78s, error-rate=0.5% (baseline p95=560ms). Host CPU 85% vs baseline 48%. Disk i/o slightly elevated.

ravi: that's pretty convincing for the new prefetch behaviour causing contention. We should avoid risking full rollout. Options: 1) rollback to previous image (v2.3.1) immediately; 2) pin release to v2.3.1 for this window and investigate preftech flag; 3) try toggling flag off on canary (hotfix image) and re-run canary. Thoughts?

elaine: change window is 35m left. Hotfix image build + deploy ~25m. Rollback is fastest and safest. I'd prefer pin/rollpin to v2.3.1 so we keep the window moving.

pat: commands to run if we rollpin:
```
# pin to previous image
deploybot pin promote --release v2.3.1 --by elaine --reason "canary latency regression - rollpin"
# trigger rollback if already half-promoted
deploybot rollback --release v2.3.1 --by elaine --reason "canary p95 >> SLO"
```

deploy-bot: Awaiting manual confirmation to pin/rollback. Current canary state: 3% traffic to commit qwe987asd, 97% to v2.3.1.

ravi: given the CPU spike and fd noise, I'm in favor of rollpin. We can run a controlled hotfix build overnight to investigate prefetch.

elaine: agree. Rolling back now. Executing pin and rollback commands.

deploy-bot: Manual pin request received by elaine. Release pinned to v2.3.1.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by elaine to v2.3.1. Canary traffic reverted. Rollback completed successfully.

metrics-bot: Post-rollback snapshot (5m after): p95=590ms, p50=110ms, error-rate=0.2%. CPU back to baseline.

pat: adding entry to release notes: "Rollpin: reverted canary to v2.3.1 due to p95 latency regression caused by experimental --prefetch-cache=true. Investigation flagged for infra and runtime teams."

ravi: filing INFRA-2502 assigned to runtime-team for follow-up. Suggested investigation items: reproduce preftech behavior under load, check fd leak / open file limits, and validate prefetch eviction logic.

elaine: ok for this window we keep v2.3.1. We'll re-run canary with prefetch disabled and re-evaluate. Scheduling a debrief tomorrow. Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
